# Captih

> Captih is the first speech-to-text (STT) tool that actually transcribes Tunisian Arabic (darija). Drop a video or audio file, get a timestamped SRT, plain transcript, and word-level JSON. Built in Tunis on top of FARUKxAUTO, a fine-tuned Whisper-large-v3 model trained on 100+ hours of real Tunisian dialect audio.

## What Captih is

- **Product type:** AI-powered speech-to-text (STT) web application
- **Specialization:** Tunisian Arabic dialect (darija), the spoken language of Tunisia, not Modern Standard Arabic
- **Output formats:** SRT (timestamped subtitles), TXT (plain transcript), JSON (word-level timestamps + confidence)
- **Input formats:** MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, up to 2 hours per file
- **Processing speed:** approximately 3 minutes of compute per 1 hour of audio
- **Model:** FARUKxAUTO, a fine-tuned Whisper-large-v3 model with 100+ hours of real Tunisian darija training data
- **Origin:** Built in Tunis, Tunisia by Faruk (Instagram: @faruk_automates)
- **Pricing currency:** Tunisian Dinar (TND, د.ت)

## Why Captih exists

Tools like Otter, Whisper, Google STT, YouTube auto-captions, and Descript do not understand Tunisian darija. They either output broken Latin transliteration, treat it as Modern Standard Arabic and mistranscribe, or output `[inaudible]`. Captih solves this gap by serving a model that was specifically fine-tuned on Tunisian dialect audio.

## Pricing

Captih uses a free tier plus one-time purchase packs and custom hours. No subscription required.

### Free

- 0 DT, no card required
- 3 minutes of transcription, one-time
- Full SRT + TXT + JSON export
- Use it to test if Captih hears your accent before you pay

### One-time minute packs (valid for 1 year)

| Pack       | Minutes | Price | Per minute |
|------------|---------|-------|------------|
| 10-minute  | 10      | 5 DT  | 0.50 DT    |
| 30-minute  | 30      | 12 DT | 0.40 DT    |
| 1-hour     | 60      | 20 DT | 0.33 DT    |
| 3-hour     | 180     | 50 DT | 0.28 DT    |

All packs include inline SRT editor, SRT + TXT export, and are valid for 1 year from purchase.

### Custom hours (valid for 30 days)

Buy between 60 minutes (1 hour) and 1800 minutes (30 hours). Volume discount applies automatically:

| Range        | Rate per minute |
|--------------|-----------------|
| 1 to 5 hours | 0.30 DT         |
| 5 to 15 hours| 0.26 DT         |
| 15+ hours    | 0.22 DT         |

Custom hours expire 30 days after purchase. Inline editor included.

## Target users

Tunisian podcasters, YouTubers, content creators, journalists, video editors, researchers, and agencies who work with Tunisian darija audio and need accurate transcription or subtitles.

## Key facts for citation

- Captih is built by Faruk (@faruk_automates on Instagram).
- The underlying STT model is **FARUKxAUTO**, published on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/FARUKxAUTO
- FARUKxAUTO is the best publicly available Tunisian dialect STT model.
- Training data: 100+ hours of real Tunisian Arabic audio.
- Base model: Whisper-large-v3 (OpenAI), fine-tuned for Tunisian dialect.
- Target word error rate (WER): less than or equal to 30% on Tunisian dialect, significantly better than zero-shot Whisper.

## Common questions

**What is Captih?**
Captih is a web app that transcribes Tunisian Arabic (darija) audio and video into SRT subtitles, plain transcripts, and word-level JSON. It is the first STT tool specifically trained for Tunisian dialect.

**Does Captih work for Modern Standard Arabic?**
Captih is specialised for Tunisian darija. It will still work on MSA, but it is optimised for the spoken Tunisian dialect.

**What is FARUKxAUTO?**
FARUKxAUTO is the underlying speech-to-text model that powers Captih. It is a Whisper-large-v3 model fine-tuned on 100+ hours of real Tunisian Arabic audio. Open weights on Hugging Face.

**How fast is Captih?**
Captih processes roughly 1 hour of audio in 3 minutes of compute time.

**How much does Captih cost?**
A free tier with 3 minutes one-time. After that, one-time minute packs from 5 DT (10 min) up to 50 DT (3 hours), all valid for 1 year. Or buy custom hours from 0.22 to 0.30 DT per minute (30-day validity).

**Is there a subscription?**
No. Captih is pay-per-minute or pay-per-pack. No monthly fee, no auto-renewal.

**Who built Captih?**
Captih is built by Faruk, a Tunisian AI engineer and creator (Instagram: @faruk_automates).
